Subject: Marketplace listing onboarding: asset checklist + SLA alignment for AcmeCloud

Team —

We received a request from AcmeCloud Marketplace Ops to start the listing onboarding for their co-sell program. They want the compliance precheck before we open the listing window: branding assets, claim substantiation, and support coverage (they flagged SLA requirements).

Can each of you own the bullets below and get me the artifacts by EOD Wednesday so I can send a consolidated packet to AcmeCloud and AWS marketplace ops?

- Marissa: branding & creative (logo color variants, icon SVG, acceptable usage examples, alt text). They specifically asked for a landscape and square logo at 300dpi and a 60px min on the UI.
- Ben: claims substantiation (benchmarks, model card excerpt, any third-party citations for latency/cost claims). They want short-form bullets we can include in the listing page and a 1-page claim summary.
- Rishi: support SLA mapping (support hours, escalation path, on-call rotation, severity 1 response time). Marketplace asks for documented 24x7 coverage for co-sell qualified listings — need proposed plan or an exception request.

Attachments: none from me yet. I put a shared checklist in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1GcQ-marketplace-onboarding-checklist

Goals for Wednesday send: a single PDF packet (branding + claims + SLA matrix) and one contact for emergency escalation. I will be the single point-on-file until we have a named CS owner.

Thanks —
Monica

Hi Monica / team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround — the creative samples look good. A couple of compliance items the Marketplace team needs to confirm before we move to the co-sell enablement queue: 

1) Support coverage: per AcmeCloud co-sell policy, listings in the co-sell program require documented 24x7 support with an on-call escalation path (S1 response within 1 hour and a named escalation contact). If Redwood cannot provide 24x7, we can evaluate a compensating control (e.g., dedicated on-call via partner CS with guaranteed handoff) but that requires an exception request and additional review.

2) Claim substantiation: any performance or cost claims on the listing page need one-line evidence bullets and a published test matrix or model card that includes the test harness and dataset. We can accept internal benchmarks but prefer third-party validation for public claims.

3) Branding & trademarks: the marketplace requires a short trademark statement on the listing tile if you reference other vendor technologies. Also, we require a white-background PNG at 72dpi for the marketplace hero.

I attached the marketplace policy excerpt and the co-sell checklist. Please review and confirm we can supply the S1 escalation contact.

Attachments: [Attachment: aws_marketplace_requirements.pdf (pdf)], [Attachment: acme_copilot_co_sell_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

Happy to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through if helpful.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Partner Ops, AWS Marketplace Partnerships
alicia.gomez@aws-partner.com

Alicia — appreciate the clarity and the attachments. Summary & proposed plan below so we can close this loop and move the listing into co-sell review: 

- Support coverage (owner: Rishi): Redwood will provide 24x7 on-call coverage for co-sell qualified listings via our Dedicated CS rotation. Proposed escalation path: S1 pager -> Primary CS on-call (15 min acknowledgement) -> Engineering on-call (1 hour), documented in our SLA matrix. Rishi will attach the on-call rota and PagerDuty escalation playbook by EOD Friday.

- Claims substantiation (owner: Ben): we'll provide the 1-page claim summary and a short test matrix excerpt. For public-facing claims that reference third-party numbers, we'll either add a citation or add clear language: "internal Redwood benchmarks; production results may vary." Ben will produce the final claimant bullets and include the model card extract.

- Branding & trademarks (owner: Marissa): we'll add the required trademark statement and provide the white-background PNG at 72dpi. Marissa will confirm the co-brand banner language with legal and upload the final assets.

Next steps / deadlines: 
- Rishi: on-call rota + PagerDuty playbook — due 2028-09-15 18:00 PDT
- Ben: claim summary + model card excerpt — due 2028-09-15 18:00 PDT
- Marissa: final creative + trademark language confirmation — due 2028-09-15 18:00 PDT

I will compile the packet and send to AcmeCloud and AWS marketplace by EOD 2028-09-15. HubSpot deal: HS-98765.
